PRESSURE SENSOR DETAILS
------------------------
DATA COMMENCED:   20 November 1990 (UTC), julian day 324
RECORD INTERVAL:  5 minutes
TIME SYSTEM:      UTC
MANUFACTURER:     Geokon 
SENSOR MODEL:     4500
RANGE:            350kPa
           
===========================================================

GAUGE HISTORY
------------------------
1988 - site established 15 November, recording commenced 4 days later.
1989 - transducer lost 5 February.
1990 - gauge reinstated 20 November.
1993 - gauge failed 26 September.
1994 - gauge reinstated 27 November.
2003 - data ends 18 March; re-established 23 November.
2009 - sensor malfunction late August. New sensor installed 4 December but failed 4 days later.
2010 - gauge re-established early November, recording recommended 5 November.
2021 - gauge failed 16 March, re-established 6 November.

===========================================================

FILE NAME FORMAT NOTES
-----------------------

The sea level data .zip file is named using the format
ROBT_yyyyddd.zip, where:

yyyy is the year (eg 2009)
ddd is the day of the year (eg 110, for 20 April).

The .zip file contains a single file of sea level data, 
named in the same format but using a .csv file extension.

===========================================================

SEA LEVEL DATA FORMAT - comma delimited yearly files
---------------------------------------------------

2008-2009:
1st field: site code (ROBT)
2nd field: date (yyyymmdd) UTC, 24 hour
3rd field: time (hh:mm:ss) UTC, 24 hour
4th field: sea level height (metres)

eg:
ROBT,20080117,00:05:00,6.047
ROBT,20080117,00:10:00,6.004
ROBT,20080117,00:15:00,5.992


2011-2017, 2023 (excl. 2014): 
1st field: site code (ROBT)
2nd field: date (yyyymmdd) UTC, 24 hour
3rd field: time (hh:mm:ss) UTC, 24 hour
4th field: sea level height (metres)
5th field: number of measurements per 5 min sample (max 30)
6th field: sea water temperature °C
7th field: atmospheric pressure hPa 

eg:
ROBT,20110101,0:00:00,5.345,30,-2.338,993.15
ROBT,20110101,0:05:00,5.38,30,-2.338,992.99
ROBT,20110101,0:10:00,5.389,30,-2.338,992.82


2014, 2018-2025 (excl. 2023): 
1st field: year (yyyy)
2nd field: Julian Day
3rd field: time UTC, 24 hour
4th field: number of measurements per 5 min sample (max 30)
5th field: sea level height (metres)
6th field: sea water temperature °C
7th field: atmospheric pressure hPa 

eg:
2024,1,1000,30,5.676,-3.458,973.02
2024,1,1005,30,5.675,-3.458,973.02
2024,1,1010,30,5.689,-3.458,973.02
